entities.summary: Sergey Vladimirovich Goryachev was a Russian military officer. He served as commander of the Russian 201st Military Base in Tajikistan and as chief of staff of the 35th Combined Arms Army in Belogorsk. In 2022, he was reassigned from Tajikistan to serve in the Russian invasion of Ukraine, and was later killed during the 2023 Ukrainian counteroffensive.
